title: •Wipe Them Out, All Of Them
caption: •Wipe Them Out, All Of Them (V)
game_text: Deploy on a site. Unless a player controls a battleground site, that player’s {lightsaber} weapon destiny draws are -2. During opponent’s draw phase, if opponent’s non-battleground site (with no related locations) on table, may activate or retrieve 1 Force. {alter}
lore: Darth Sidious’ command was merciless and direct. He left no room for misinterpretation.
base_page: Wipe Them Out, All Of Them

notes: Unique. Banner EFFECT, no grabber box. Inline icon black square + green blade → {lightsaber} (stub 'lightsaber'); red circle-slash A at the end → {alter} (stub 'Immune to Alter'). 'non-battleground' hyphenated across the slip's line break ('non-' / 'battleground'). Curly apostrophes as printed. Margin credits: left 'Original concept by Michael Raveling', right 'Minnesota State Winner 2004'. Coruscant base (Dark Effect); the scan shows a second small round icon under the expansion ring beside the lore box (part of the printed Coruscant frame, as noted on vs8/32), not transcribed. Lore matches the scan except: Lore apostrophes written curly ’ per Decipher typesetting and this project's convention (the wiki has straight '; not resolvable at 350 px). Base scan only at 350 px; copyright = Coruscant 2001 SE-style line (as vs5/19), not legible. Modern: Virtual Block 5 only (VB5 -pre, 355 px). Wiki also has 'Wipe Them Out, All Of Them (Dark)' — not used. Art: printed scan by its measured Episode I window (art.rect; the old trim zoomed in — Bill 2026-10-14).
